source: The difference is easiest to see in Mixtral 8x7B. Its paper reports 47B total parameters accessible to the model and 13B active parameters per token. The paper explicitly warns that active-parameter analysis does not capture weight-memory cost or hardware utilization.
zh: 在 Mixtral 8x7B 中最容易看出差异。其论文报告了模型可访问的总共 47B 个参数以及每个代币 13B 个活动参数。该论文明确警告说，主动参数分析无法捕获权重内存成本或硬件利用率。
